headline: NXP authors preserve shared block variations in a SystemC-AMS PLL performance model
fact: NXP and RPTU authors presented variation-aware PLL performance evaluation at DVCon Europe 2025. Public slides integrate statistical performance kernels into SystemC-AMS charge-pump and loop-filter models, preserving 23 shared variations between the blocks. They evaluate PLL lock-time distributions across 2,000 runs and compare approaches with independently modeled block distributions. Related NXP work appeared in 2023; this event records the 2025 evaluation rather than the methodology's first introduction.

sources.title: Performance Evaluation of a Phase-Locked Loop using Variation-Aware Behavioral Models — slides
sources.summary: Public slides by Neha Chavan, Jan Rödel, Carna Zivkovic and Christoph Grimm show shared CP/filter variation parameters, SystemC-AMS integration and lock-time distribution comparisons. The full paper was not reviewed.

sources.title: Variation-Aware Performance Verification of Analog Mixed-Signal Systems — 2023 publisher abstract
sources.summary: Publisher abstract identifies earlier NXP work using a compact linear kernel and SystemC-AMS charge-pump PLL analysis in 2023. The predecessor full text was not reviewed; it establishes prior work, not the detailed difference between the two publications.
